publications.claim_scope: Explicit Landauer and richness premises imply the minimum rate bound Supplied richness and Landauer premises imply the data-wall ceiling The explicit fair-bit KL process has intelligence creation rate log two. Given positive K and named supplied physical premises PL (R_obs*K <= P) and PD (rate <= R_obs*D), the product-form inequality rate <= P*D/K holds. The physical premises are not derived.
